EnvironmentInspect.description: Configuration for the Environment Inspector package

Exclude.description: List of exclusion rules for configuration keys or providers to exclude entirely. Can be strings (for key patterns) or objects (for provider-based exclusion).

oneOf.description: Regex pattern to match configuration keys (e.g., '^APPSETTING_' to exclude environment variables)
Exclusion rule that can match by Key, Provider, ProviderType, or ProviderSource. Multiple properties can be combined (AND logic).

Key.description: Regex pattern to match configuration keys

Provider.description: Regex pattern to match the full configuration provider name

ProviderType.description: Regex pattern to match the provider type (class name only)

ProviderSource.description: Regex pattern to match the provider source (file name or identifier)

Redact.description: List of redaction rules to apply to configuration values. Rules are processed in order, and the first match is applied.

items.description: A redaction rule that matches by Key, Provider, ProviderType, or ProviderSource. Multiple properties can be combined (AND logic).

Key.description: Regex pattern to match configuration keys

Provider.description: Regex pattern to match the full configuration provider name (e.g., 'JsonConfigurationProvider for \'appsettings.json\' (Optional)')

ProviderType.description: Regex pattern to match the provider type (class name only, e.g., 'JsonConfigurationProvider' or '.*Azure.*')

ProviderSource.description: Regex pattern to match the provider source (file name or identifier, e.g., 'appsettings.Development.json' or '.*Development.*')

RedactionMode.description: The type of redaction to apply

RedactionOptions.description: Additional options for Advanced redaction mode

KeepFirst.description: Number of characters to keep visible at the start of the value

KeepLast.description: Number of characters to keep visible at the end of the value

Keys.description: List of nested keys to redact within the value (useful for connection strings)

items.description: Key name to extract and redact (e.g., 'Password', 'PWD', 'User Id')

RedactionCharacter.description: The character to use for redaction

PartialVisibleChars.description: Number of characters to show at the start and end in Partial redaction mode

AzureWebAppAdvancedCopy.description: Enable Azure Web App advanced copy feature with JSON snippet generation in the dashboard
